title: Affine morphism gives a quasi-coherent derived equivalence
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Regard $f_*\mathcal O_X$ as an $\mathcal O_Y$-algebra. Then $Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] induces an equivalence $\Phi:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\simeq D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(f_*\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], where the target is the full subcategory of the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of the abelian category of $f_*\mathcal O_X$-modules on $Y$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] consisting of the complexes whose cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent $f_*\mathcal O_X$-modules [lem-weil-pbc-affine-module-correspondence], and the composition of $\Phi$ with the restriction functor $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(f_*\mathcal O_X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ is $Rf_*:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$.

proof.text: Obtain the ambient derived tensor pullback L and its adjunction to Rg_* from [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general].

Restriction of scalars T is exact by the finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation declarations in [def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module], specialized to the algebra Under.mk f.c. The underived composite g_* followed by T is definitionally f_*. The source-library exact-postcomposition theorem rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso and rightDerivedFunctorNatIso give Rg_* followed by RT naturally isomorphic to Rf_*; rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory identifies RT with levelwise scalar restriction. No K-injective preservation by g_* is assumed.

For each degree, rightDerivedFunctorHomologyFunctorIso identifies the cohomology of RT with scalar restriction of cohomology. Clause (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-module-correspondence] implies RT preserves quasi-coherent cohomology. To show Rg_* does too, compose this homology comparison with the derived composite comparison and [lem-sc-affine-derived-cohomology]. Scalar restriction of H^i(Rg_*K) is isomorphic to f_*H^i(K), which is quasi-coherent; clause (1) reflects quasi-coherence back to the algebra module.

Use [lem-sc-affine-algebra-derived-adjunction-qcoh] to preserve quasi-coherence under L. Lift L and Rg_* to the full subcategories with ObjectProperty.lift, and restrict the adjunction using Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful. The inclusion images of its unit and counit are the ambient maps, composed with identity comparisons. They are isomorphisms by [lem-sc-affine-algebra-derived-adjunction-isos]. Fully faithful inclusions reflect isomorphisms. Apply Adjunction.toEquivalence and take its inverse equivalence, so the forward functor is the restricted Rg_*.

Lift RT to the full quasi-coherent subcategory on Y to define S. Both lift/inclusion comparisons are definitional identity isomorphisms. Whisker the composite comparison of Step 2 with the source inclusion to obtain E.functor followed by S and inclusion naturally isomorphic to the source inclusion followed by Rf_*. This proves all three comparison clauses.
